text:
Alex: Short thread to lock down postmortem follow-ups from the DB outage. We keep getting drift on owners and timelines. Need a tiny, enforceable process.

Priya: Proposed minimal row template for the tracker: Action | Owner | Created | Due | Verify | Status | Recurrence | Pattern. Keep rows small and require owner on creation. Example:
```
Rotate replica config | @Priya | 2025-10-28 | 2025-11-04 | `./smoke --replica-check` + 24h window | open | quarterly | replication
```

Sam: IC rotation note: 2-week IC shifts felt reasonable in the outage. Add explicit handoff message template: `IC HANDOFF: from @oldIC to @newIC | status: <short> | blockers: <list>` and pin a one-line checklist in the channel. Also suggest a sandboxed dry-run of handoffs once a quarter. :spiral_calendar:

Jun: Communications cadence suggestion: initial ack <=5m, owner assigned <=15m, status updates every 30-60m depending on severity, final postmortem summary + action stub within 48h. For remediation follow-ups require owners to post a 1-2 sentence plan within 48h and weekly progress updates in the tracker until verified.

Priya: I'll stand up the Sheet + automation. Plan: one tab for active actions, one for timeline templates, and a pivot for "incident pattern" trends. Reminders to owners on due_date and a weekly digest of overdue/recurring items to #postmortems.

ops-bot: Reminder: 5 open postmortem actions from last incident. Owners: @Priya, @Sam, @Alex, @Jun, @OpsOncall. Reply `ack` to snooze.

Alex: Action list from thread:
- Priya: create tracker + timeline template + sample rows (due 2025-10-31)
- Sam: draft IC handoff template + pinned checklist (due 2025-11-03)
- Jun: write comms cadence + owner-update expectations doc (due 2025-10-30)
- Alex: collect outstanding PM actions and map tentative owners (due 2025-10-29)

Sam: For verification steps, we should include exact commands and a stability window. Example: `curl /health && ./smoke-replicas.sh` then monitor metrics for 24h.

Jun: Agreed. Also flag every action with a pattern tag (replication/deploy/monitoring/infra) so quarterly reports can highlight repeats.

Priya: Acknowledged. I'll post the sheet link and automation details here when ready. If anyone wants ownership changes, update the tracker and ping the thread. :white_check_mark:
